title: Illustration / Shape language / Rhythm
slide_intent: Vary visual weight because a sequence of identical proportions gives the eye little to discover.
strategic_value: Contrasting shape sizes can give Duolingo characters more individual stories while retaining simple construction.
demonstration: Uniform pink block stacks contrast with varied blue stacks above two rows of character silhouettes and overlays.
practical_value: Compare a character’s large and small masses before adding surface detail.

content_islands.name: Abstract rhythm
content_islands.spec: Place the repeated pink blocks beside three varied blue stacks across the top of the figure.

content_islands.name: Character comparison
content_islands.spec: Arrange pink and blue silhouettes with translucent character overlays in two rows below.

content_islands.name: Rhythm rationale
content_islands.spec: Explain visual weight and the melody analogy in the right column.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source compares variation in visual weight to varied musical notes and says rhythm can communicate a character’s story.
reference_purposes.Application: Abstract block arrangements and character overlays demonstrate how proportion changes the rhythm of a silhouette.

ingredient.name: Variation in shape weight
ingredient.role: Give the viewer a changing rhythm within a simple silhouette.
ingredient.application: Vary the relative sizes and proportions of component shapes instead of repeating equally weighted blocks.
ingredient.scope: Historical character illustration examples; no numerical proportion or mandatory asymmetry is supplied.
